statement: There is exactly one constitutional state machine per governed capability. The bridge, the Journey Spine UI, Copilot/MCP, IRL OS, and any future interface are projections and actuation channels around that single runtime state -- never independent holders of it. A constitutional act (delegation, deposit, freeze, signature) is complete the moment the canonical write lands, regardless of which channel performed it; every other channel's next read must reflect it immediately, with no re-enactment and no channel-specific 'catch up' step.
